text:
sandra_cs: Quick sync from StratusHealth onboarding call — customer raised three related asks blocking confidence for go-live: embedding freshness (they see results >12h old), missing per-route cost visibility for billing owners, and wanting role-based access for generation templates.
sandra_cs: Renewal check-in in ~10 weeks; CSM flagged medium risk if embed freshness not addressed.
julie_cs: Customer quote: "we reindex nightly but users see old answers for same query, breaking trust" — pasted example query + doc id into the ticket.
noah_pm: Agree we should triage impact vs effort. Recommend a short technical spike on embedding freshness (highest trust/regression risk).
arjun_eng: Current infra TTL for embedding cache is 24h (cache.ttl=86400). We run full reindex nightly. Incremental invalidation needs index changes and a small streaming consumer. Rough estimate: spike 3d, implementation ~2w.
maria_data: I'll pull metrics (requery rate, duplicate queries, customers affected). Need at least 5 similar incidents to justify full infra work.
sandra_cs: They reported four different internal teams hit the issue in the first week, so likely we have enough signal.
opsbot: New ticket created: CS-4822 — "StratusHealth embedding staleness + per-route billing ask" (assigned to product).
noah_pm: Proposal: treat embedding spike as P0 to surface repro and telemetry. Per-route billing and RBAC templating as P1/P2. If spike is a small infra change we can fast-follow.
arjun_eng: I'll own the spike. Plan: reproduce with their sample, simulate reindex cadence, and evaluate two approaches: shrink TTL vs event-driven invalidation. I'll post findings in 3 days and open an infra RFC if needed.
julie_cs: I'll gather 5 support threads + example prompts and share links. I'll also ask Stratus for permission to run a synthetic requery test in their staging.
maria_data: After metrics are in I'll compute a severity score (incidents/week, impacted users, renewal exposure) and add it to CS-4822.
sandra_cs: For comms to Stratus: can we get a short blurb outlining next steps? Even a one-line acknowledgement helps with renewal.
noah_pm: I'll draft a one-paragraph turnaround note once arjun posts spike results. Tagging @product-leads for visibility :eyes:.
sandra_cs: Thanks — reconvene after spike notes. :thumbsup:
